title: Fitting Bay Standards Sheet for the Equipment Rental and Demo Line
content:
## Fitting ranges and hire terms, Equipment Rental and Demo

A package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line is fitted within the age, height and weight range held against it, and an agreement on that package runs for a number of days between its shortest and its longest term. The sheet also records, package by package, whether a signed liability release must be on file before the kit is handed over and whether a photographic identity document must be shown when the kit is collected.

| Package | Age, whole years | Rider height, cm | Rider weight, kg | Shortest term, days | Longest term, days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 3 to 12 | 90 to 155 | 14 to 55 | 1 | 21 |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 13 to 85 | 140 to 200 | 35 to 125 | 1 | 21 |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 13 to 85 | 145 to 200 | 38 to 125 | 1 | 21 |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 16 to 85 | 155 to 205 | 45 to 135 | 1 | 14 |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 16 to 85 | 155 to 205 | 45 to 135 | 1 | 7 |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 3 to 85 | 90 to 205 | 14 to 135 | 60 | 180 |

| Package | Signed liability release on file | Photographic identity document at the counter |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | required | not required |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | required | required |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | required | required |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | required | required |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | required | required |
| Season-Long Lease Package | required | required |

### The figures defined

The youngest and oldest ages are the youngest and oldest age in whole years a rider is fitted in the package. The height figures are the shortest and tallest rider height in centimetres the package is fitted for, and the weight figures the lightest and heaviest rider weight in kilograms. The shortest term is the fewest days an agreement for the package may run for, and the longest term the most days it may run for before it becomes a season lease.

### Where the ranges meet

The Junior Ski & Board Rental is fitted from age 3 to age 12 and the Basic and Sport packages from age 13, so the two bands meet without overlap and without a gap. Height does not divide the line as cleanly. The Junior package is fitted up to 155 cm and the Performance and Demo packages from 155 cm, so those bands meet at a figure they share rather than abutting as the age bands do, and a rider of exactly 155 cm falls inside all three. The Basic package begins at 140 cm and the Sport package at 145 cm, both of them overlapping the Junior band from below. The Season-Long Lease Package spans the whole of the line's fitting range, from age 3 to age 85, 90 cm to 205 cm and 14 kg to 135 kg, and is the one package whose shortest term, 60 days, is longer than the longest term of any day-hire package.

### Points of judgement on this sheet

**A rider of 13 years and 138 cm (a hypothetical rider).** The age is outside the Junior band of 3 to 12 and inside the Basic and Sport band of 13 to 85; the height is below the Basic package's 140 cm and below the Sport package's 145 cm. Of the day-hire packages of the line, none of the ranges on this sheet holds that rider in both age and height.

**A rider of 16 years, 160 cm and 50 kg (a hypothetical rider).** The age, the height and the weight all fall inside the ranges held against the Basic, Sport, Performance and Demo packages, and inside the range held against the Season-Long Lease Package. The age falls outside the Junior band.

**A signed release.** A signed liability release stands as required against every package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line; only the Junior Ski & Board Rental carries no requirement for a photographic identity document at the counter.
